learning.why: The teacher's whiteboard note 'Pizza: 2 trijya + chaap' and 'Seedha cut: jeeva + chaa' showed exactly why sector has two straight sides and segment has one — I see the difference now.
The whiteboard comparison directly contradicted my swapped idea — pizza slice can't be a segment if it has two straight edges.

end.summary:
Circle parts were practised: radius, chord, diameter, arc, segment, and sector.
Dev related diameter, radius, and chords correctly in 4 of 4 unaided attempts.
Dev mixed up sector and segment twice; the distinction was discussed during the lesson.
Circle rotation and reflection symmetry were practised; the number of symmetry lines remained unsettled.
end.parentNote: Asha practised the names of circle parts, the relationship between radius and diameter, chord limits, and circle symmetries with Dev. Dev used the fact that a diameter is twice the radius and explained that a chord need not pass through the centre. The sector–segment mix-up was discussed, but it was not fully settled by the last check; the number of lines of symmetry also needed another review. At home, ask Dev to label a pizza-slice-shaped sector and a chord-with-arc segment, then draw several diameters through a circle and count the symmetry lines.

Sahi, bina nishaan wala gol vritt kisi bhi kone par ghoomne ke baad waisa hi dikhega. Ab ghoomne ki jagah use seedhi rekha par modne ki sochiye. Vritt mein sammiti ki kitni rekhaen ho sakti hain?
circle की symmetry? वो तो... 4 होती हैं ना? जैसे square की होती हैं, upar, neeche, left, right – चार.

Aap vritt ki sammiti rekhaen varg ki tarah chaar maan rahe hain. Varg ko tirchhi rekha par modne se dono hisse hamesha nahi milte, par bina nishaan wale vritt mein kendra se guzarti rekha ko kisi bhi disha mein rakhein, dono hisse milte hain. Agar rekha thodi aur ghuma dein, kya woh bhi sammiti rekha hogi?
थोड़ी और घुमाएँ तो... वो भी symmetry होगी? मतलब जितनी मर्ज़ी बना लो?
Haan, kendra se guzarti rekha ko aur ghumayein, to woh bhi sammiti rekha hogi. Har nayi disha mein dono aadhe milenge. To vritt mein sammiti rekhaon ki kul sankhya kitni hogi?
अब तो अनगिनत? जितनी diameter खींच सको उतनी symmetry lines?

Aapne har vyaas ko sammiti rekha se joda. Kendra se guzarti rekha kisi bhi disha mein ho sakti hai, isliye aisi rekhaen anaginat hain. Ab ek hissa do trijyaon aur ek chaap se ghira ho, to use kya kahenge?
